---
name: Kontra coordinator role detection
description: How to correctly identify coordinator/owner roles across standard and custom workspace packs
---

## The rule

Use `isCoordinatorRole(r)` which checks BOTH conditions:

```js
const isCoordinatorRole = r =>
  r.invitable === false || (r.canManage === true && r.invitable !== true);
```

**Why:** Standard packs (cre_acquisition, business_acquisition, fundraising, tokenization) mark their coordinator role with `invitable: false`. Custom `ws_*` packs generated by the pack builder set `canManage: true` but do NOT always set `invitable: false`. Checking only `invitable === false` misses custom-pack coordinator roles, causing them to appear as "Not invited" with an Invite button.

**Standard pack coordinator keys:** `owner` (CRE), `buyer` (Business), `founder` (Fundraising), `issuer` (Tokenization), plus `franchisor` (CRE) — all have `invitable: false` in `shared/workflowRoles.json`.

**How to apply:** Wherever roles are split into coordinator vs. participant lists (e.g., ParticipantsPanel), always use the dual-condition check. Never rely on `invitable === false` alone when custom packs may be in play.
